author: Unity
description:
Nomada Studio, the creators of GRIS, discuss the vision and technical process behind their new title, Neva. This Barcelona-based studio is dedicated to making games as art, so empowering their artists is key. Get a peek at the custom tools – including a texture resizer and their own build server – that allow their artists to push for a strong visual identity while the tech team keeps performance and memory in check across seven gaming platforms.

Play the Neva: Prologue DLC: https://on.unity.com/NevaPrologue

Watch more videos: https://on.unity.com/resources

[0:00] – Intro
[0:40] – Balancing quality and performance
[2:00] – Unlocking creativity

#MadeWithUnity #GameDev #IndieGames #UnityAssetStore #HDRP
title: How Nomada Studio shipped Neva on 7 platforms with custom tools
